hypotheses.reasoning: auth-svc-2 drained for rollout (capacity 3/4), a small, survivable drop. account-svc retries 503s right away with backoff disabled (up to 4 attempts), so inbound rate climbed to 3-5x baseline and auth-svc kept shedding load with 503. That self-sustaining retry storm is why the errors don't recover. Edge 503s are downstream of this.
The rollout started the capacity dip. But the logs show no code fault from it.

verdict.recommendedAction: Turn on exponential backoff with jitter and a retry budget in account-svc's AuthClient. Pause the auth-svc rollout or scale auth-svc up until the retry storm drains. Rate-limit /login at edge-proxy for now.
